861:t_011:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Everyone, play however you like. I really still haven't had my fill, but... Well, see you!」

861:t_012:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Oh... Are you taking a break? I'm getting hungry too, so that's perfect.」

861:t_012:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You can't even play games on an empty stomach. Once we've eaten, let's fight together again.」

861:t_012:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「See you! Make sure you eat plenty of good food too!」

861:t_013:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Huh? You want special training now? I'm not putting up with that.」

861:t_013:4.en:
$$シリウス$$
「We need it to win the battles ahead. Enough arguing. We're starting, $$アポロ$$.」

861:t_013:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then do it by yourself. Your training assignment is to read the exit message with your combining face.」

861:t_013:6.en:
$$シリウス$$
「All you plaaayers! I'm counting on yoooou to plaaaay agaaaain!!」

861:t_013:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...You beat me this time, $$シリウス$$...」

861:t_014:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, you're stopping here? You've worked hard. Then I'll take the next turn...」

861:t_014:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$千鳥$$. A simulation is meaningless unless it uses accurate data.」

861:t_014:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Attacking a fighter plane with a $$単分子カッター|lc$$ would never happen in reality. It's utter nonsense.」

861:t_014:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「How can you casually say something that rejects the whole premise of this game?」

861:t_014:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Just hand over that data. I'll adjust the stats to be as realistic as possible...」

861:t_015:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, come on! That fumo-fumo is so annoying!」

861:t_015:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Give the players a proper greeting! A proper one!」

861:t_015:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Polish your gun thoroughly before bed!」

861:t_015:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You should have said to brush their teeth...」

861:t_016:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Use 'Valor'! What else are you going to do but beat the enemies coming at you!?」

861:t_016:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「No, we should use 'Alert' and retreat here!」

861:t_016:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You've gotten ten game overs because you charge in without thinking!」

861:t_016:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's fine! I'm still way better than a captain who can't be counted on in a real operation!」

861:t_016:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Argh! I've had enough! Let's have $$相良$$ decide!」

861:t_016:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Which will it be, $$宗介$$!? Valor!? Alert!?」

861:t_017:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are you doing here, Sergeant?」

861:t_017:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Sergeant, you've made Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ an ace, of course?」

861:t_017:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「As a submarine, $$ＴＤＤ－１$$ has problems with terrain ratings...」

861:t_017:7.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Are you making excuses?」

861:t_017:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I would never do that, sir!」

861:t_017:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Listen. We must prove that with that ship's and the Captain's capabilities, terrain ratings pose no obstacle!」

861:t_017:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If you say you can't, Sergeant... I'll stuff you into a torpedo tube and fire you out with 300 kilos of explosives!」

861:t_017:11.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I swear by God and Her Majesty the Queen, I'll tear you limb from limb! Do you understand!!」

861:t_018:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Whew, we're done, we're done! ...Or so I thought. What are you doing, $$宗介$$?」

861:t_018:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm studying. I have a test soon. 'Let's build in 1185'... the Muromachi shogunate.」

861:t_018:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「It's Kamakura! Can you really earn your credits like that?」

861:t_018:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not good at Japanese history...」

861:t_018:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「All you student players, don't end up like $$宗介$$!」

861:t_018:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Play in moderation, and study a fair bit!」

861:t_019:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Whoa! You look awful! Why don't you take a break along with the player?」

861:t_019:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't do that! As the one entrusted with everyone's lives, I must always devise the best operation...」

861:t_019:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Hey, wait, $$メリッサ$$! Where are you touching me!? That tiiickles!」

861:t_019:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「Yes, that's the face! You're not cute at all with your brow all furrowed.」

861:t_019:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Honestly! You could've just told me to rest! I understand. I'll take a proper break.」

861:t_019:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'm glad you're listening! Well, see you players laaater, too!」

861:t_020:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh, you're stopping here. You've worked hard.」

861:t_020:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Getting proper rest when you can is an important duty too.」

861:t_020:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But once you've had a good rest, please be sure to come back here.」

861:t_020:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is a request, rather than an order. I'll be waiting the whole time.」

861:t_021:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're stopping? This is a good time. Take a nice, long break.」

861:t_021:4.en:
$$アル$$
「I have one piece of advice. You cannot rest with your nerves on edge. I recommend jokes to relax your state of mind.」

861:t_021:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Jests and puns liven up the atmosphere. Sergeant, please give us an outstanding joke.」

861:t_021:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Then let's say you'll have it ready by next time... Everyone, please look forward to it.」

861:t_022:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh, I'm impressed you're stopping here. Driving yourself too hard won't get you anywhere.」

861:t_022:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So, would you like to watch a movie now for a change of pace?」

861:t_022:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Right now, our esteemed team leader is watching one of his beloved classic children's anime...」

861:t_022:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oops, that was one of the Lieutenant's classified matters.」

861:t_022:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm getting out of here, so make up some excuse for me! See you!」

861:t_023:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh, I'm impressed you're stopping here. Driving yourself too hard won't get you anywhere.」

861:t_023:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So, would you like to watch a movie now for a change of pace?」

861:t_023:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Right now, our esteemed team leader is watching one of his beloved classic children's anime...」

861:t_023:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oops, that was one of the Captain's classified matters.」

861:t_023:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm getting out of here, so make up some excuse for me! See you!」

861:t_024:4.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Balance is what matters in games and in life.」

861:t_024:5.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Doing anything too much is bad! I mean, it's baaad!」

861:t_024:6.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This is what happens when you ignore my advice and overdo it.」
